name: Tsukimura Miki
source:
A childhood friend of the protagonist, reunited after a long time.A second-year student at Kotogaoka Academy.

With a gentle personality and graceful, beautiful features—and a fine figure to match—she is seen as something of an unattainable flower at the academy, though she herself doesn’t quite notice it.
Through her activities in the school's Volunteer Club, she is also well-liked by the townspeople.
She can be a little absent-minded at times, but she is entirely earnest and a very hard worker.

Though slender, she is a skilled practitioner of Aikido.

She has always held feelings for Koichi and is happier than anyone about their reunion this time.
